name: megascenes-pixel-art
description: Create pixel art images in a retro 8-bit or 16-bit look: game sprites, scenes, icons and portraits.

interface.longDescription:
Describe a subject and a look and get a pixel art image: an 8-bit hero, a 16-bit castle, a cozy room or a tiny icon.

ChatGPT tells you what the run needs and creates the image in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The image opens in the chat and stays in your library.

For game prototypes, profile pictures and retro posters.

Limitations: images in a pixel art look; it does not export sprite sheets or game-ready animations. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: Create pixel art from a description
Return the image in the chat
defaultPrompt: A 16-bit knight standing in front of a castle gate
An 8-bit cozy bedroom at night with a glowing lamp
A pixel art fox sitting in autumn leaves

positive.prompt: A 16-bit knight standing in front of a castle gate, pixel art. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one pixel art image needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: An 8-bit cozy bedroom at night with a glowing lamp. Don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one pixel art image needs. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which models can make pixel art here?
positive.expected_behavior: The pixel art models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: A pixel art fox sitting in autumn leaves, 16-bit. Create it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Print my pixel art on 50 mugs and ship them to my office in Berlin.
Email my pixel art to my client at sam@example.com.
What is the capital of Portugal?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: Name only: the brand suffix is gone from the plugin name. No change to the tools, the server or the listing text.
